panels.description: Sitara faces Roman beside the aligned records. Her copied Merritt files lie between them. Leave upper-left clear for her admission.
Roman’s hand rests near the treatment file without covering it. Leave upper-right clear for his admission.
Sitara looks directly at Roman, controlled but accusatory. Leave upper-left clear for her short line.
The two separate TJs remain physically apart. Their displays show different local partitions and different record counts. Leave the lower area clear; no dialogue.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: I took the safeguards and provenance records from Merritt.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: Croft asked me to continue unauthorized T-ALL chemistry.
